text: Appeal of Order to Comply (June 29, 2018) for 3 Grey Point Crescent.

The Property Standards Committee, Scarborough Panel: 1. Confirmed the order to comply (June 29, 2018) for 3 Point Grey Crescent, Folder No. 16 229574 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to April 30, 2019, to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City and provide a progress report to the Municipal Standards Officer, Scarborough District.
